<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_3DPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Instruction" name="Project instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="3D model STL"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Requested changes"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="You" processRef="Process_Requester"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instruction" name="Project instruction" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_Instruction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="3D model STL" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Requester" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create a project" messageRef="Message_Instruction"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches to artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_STL_Merge" name="Receive initial or revised model"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL from artist" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfaction" name="Satisfied with the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock" name="Color in stock at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check amount of color left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Under 100 grams?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PlasticAvailable" name="Plastic available">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_PlasticAvailable">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">plasticAvailable</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Continue with plastic"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrintPrepSplit" name="Prepare printing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Heat bed and extruder while receiving printer status"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrintPrepJoin" name="Printing preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Gateway_STL_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Gateway_STL_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_STL_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfaction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfaction" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfaction" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_Stock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_ShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Event_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Event_PlasticAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PrintPrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_PrintPrepSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_PrintPrepSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PrintPrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PrintPrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_PrintPrepJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_ModelPrinted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
